messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Sev2 — model-serving-queue-high-latency. Affected: hosted inference, ~15% higher p95. Pager: @alex. Link: <https://incidents/reports/1802|incident-1802>

alex: ack i'm on it. looking at queue metrics now.

alex: rerouting new requests to fallback pool... running `curl -XPOST https://infra/route -d '{"policy":"fallback"}'`

maria: what's customer impact? any user-facing errors?

alex: no 5xxs, just high tail latency causing timeouts for some long-streaming requests (~3 customers saw >30s). Support notified @support-bot

support-bot: Notifying customers A, B by email template 2.1

kevin: can we get a quick handoff if you need to escalate? i'll coordinate postmortem and follow-ups.

alex: handing off to @dana for overnight. Current mitigation: fallback pool in place, traffic 30% diverted, p95 down from 3.2s to 1.1s. Root cause candidate: KV cache eviction change in last deploy.

dana: picked up. stepping through deploy diffs now. can someone paste the deploy id?

alex: deploy `release-2026.03.14-83f2` — added sharded kv cache patch. logs show spikes around 18:03.

maria: paste log snippet

alex: ```2026-03-14T18:03:12Z ERROR cache/kv.go:214 eviction: shard 2 exceeded threshold, retries=4
2026-03-14T18:03:14Z WARN runtime/serve.go:421 slow token generation p95=3.2s
```

dana: ok that's consistent. action items: 1) revert patch to kv-sharding on dedicated pools (sev=high, size=small, owner=@alex), 2) add e2e stress test for kv eviction (sev=medium, size=medium, owner=@dana), 3) add telemetry alert for shard retries (sev=low, size=small, owner=@maria). i'll file them and link to Q3 reliability epic.

kevin: please add ETA and estimate in story points. we need to prioritize in next planning — this should be Q3 infra reliability.

alex: revert PR ready, will ship in next 15m. size=1SP. will follow up in postmortem.

dana: i'll schedule postmortem Tue 10am PT, invite SRE, runtime, product. @product-ops can you confirm calendar?

product-ops: confirmed, sending invite and postmortem template. please add customer impact summary and timeline.

maria: incident timeline for postmortem: 18:02 alert, 18:05 mitigation started, 18:20 fallback routing applied, 18:35 p95 normalized.

kevin: for action item sizing, propose mapping: small=1sp, medium=3sp, large=8sp. Mark 1) small, 2) medium, 3) small. Tie 2) to Q3 epic 'kv-resilience'.

dana: noted. i'll create the three tickets and link them here + assign labels: severity/production, quarter/Q3. will include cost estimate for dedicated capacity fallback.

alex: revert deployed, monitoring shows p95 stable. will close page after 1h observation. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. tagging for post-incident owner @dana.

support-bot: Customers A,B updated at 18:47 with workaround note.
